steps.title: Draw the sun
steps.instruction: Type the changed lines, then press Run. The turtle starts in the center, facing right.
steps.explain: dot(100) stamps a filled circle centered on the turtle. Its input is the full width.
steps.expected: A golden sun in the center.
steps.question: How is dot(100) different from circle(100)?
steps.answer: dot uses the full width. circle uses the radius and traces an outline.
